Definition: conjunction, i.e. society; mostly adverb or preposition (with prepositional prefix), near, beside, along with
BiblicalUsage: ʻummâh stands behind the English phrase near, beside. In Exodus 25:27, Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table, and it appears again in Leviticus 3:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the nearness this word marks is how God placed His furniture, close and exact, in His house.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
